description: Keeps the starter current. A project made from it decides for itself whether to keep this: each Renovate PR runs the PR check.

packageRules.description: One PR a week for everything that is not a major.
PrimeVue 5, @primeuix/themes 3 and primeicons 8 are no longer MIT (PrimeUI licence, key required). Stay on the last MIT majors.
The root TypeScript is the one typescript-eslint loads, and it supports < 6.1 only. The workspaces run TypeScript 7.
